description: David's search for control and a cure takes him from a profound relationship in Hawaii through towns, institutions and criminal schemes where his medical instincts repeatedly pull him into other people's crises.

s02e01-02.description: David travels to Hawaii seeking help from psychologist Carolyn Fields, whose experimental treatment offers hope even as her own terminal illness draws them close.

s02e03.description: A struggling resort town invents a fake woodland monster to attract tourists, only for sightings of the real Hulk to draw McGee and a ruthless hunter.

s02e04.description: At a racetrack, David befriends a vulnerable young man who is manipulated into driving a dangerously defective car in a demolition derby.

s02e05.description: David seeks a Native American horse trainer whose calming herbal compound might offer a clue to controlling his transformations.

s02e06.description: Working at an elementary school, David becomes convinced that a pupil is being abused at home and tries to protect him.

s02e07.description: A blind Chinese philosopher teaches David methods of self-control, but a former student has twisted the same teachings toward violence.

s02e08.description: David works at a disco and tries to help a talented young dancer whose drinking is destroying both her career and herself.

s02e09.description: David joins a professional football staff and tries to curb the violent behavior of a star player carrying old aggression onto the field.

s02e10.description: A crooked journalist photographs David while targeting a Chicago restaurant, threatening to put his face in print and bring McGee straight to him.

s02e11.description: David and a recently widowed woman are framed for murder by a corrupt sheriff and forced to flee while handcuffed together.

s02e12.description: Working on an oil rig, David is drawn into a sabotage campaign by competitors determined to ruin the independent operation.

s02e13.description: David retreats to the Baja wilderness to avoid the stresses that trigger the Hulk, only for a fugitive doctor to bring danger into his isolation.

s02e14.description: At a neighborhood car wash, David tries to protect two orphaned brothers from a drug dealer while one child's diabetes makes the stakes immediate.

s02e15.description: David helps a woman return to her childhood home, where memories of her dead twin and increasingly disturbing events suggest the past is not finished with her.

s02e16.description: An accident leaves David injured and amnesiac, placing him beside Jack McGee without either man realizing how close the reporter is to his quarry.

s02e17.description: David and McGee struggle through the wilderness after a plane crash while David's returning memory threatens to reveal his identity.

s02e18.description: David revisits Li Sung and becomes involved with a young police officer whose grief is turning the philosopher's teachings into a path of revenge.

s02e19.description: David accidentally frees a delusional man from custody and races to protect him and everyone around him before the situation turns deadly.

s02e20.description: An archaeological expedition finds evidence of a prehistoric Hulk, giving David hope that the ancient mutation may also point toward a cure.

s02e21.description: A timid man claims to be the Hulk, and McGee's investigation of the false confession brings him dangerously near David's latest hiding place.

s02e22.description: Working as a psychiatric orderly, David discovers a doctor conducting unethical experiments and is forcibly confined when he tries to expose them.

s02e23.description: David falls in with a modern-day outlaw couple bombing gas stations as part of a personal campaign of revenge.
